names: the vote rule (R1, R3, R5, C(iii); docs/records/2026-11-10-the-proposal-vote-rule-design.md §9): a build's `draw_agreement` records R1's gate — `modal_count`, `required`, `passes` and `rule`, the lean and the state derived from them — over the draws ATTEMPTED, a failed, unparsed or unrecognized draw counting as dissent, and the tally keys two spellings of one lean as one. At five draws with every draw completed R1 passes only 5 of 5, today's rule; a build with a failed draw now withholds where it proposed before (the 1-of-5 hole). A page built before the fields omits them and decides by `unanimous` as before, so no committed page moves until it is re-assembled
